# YIC Inflatable Sports

> YIC Inflatable Sports Co., Ltd. is a commercial inflatable manufacturer for global B2B buyers. The company manufactures bounce houses, bounce house combos, inflatable slides, obstacle courses, interactive games, tents, water attractions, advertising inflatables, and custom OEM/ODM projects.

## Primary Pages

- [Commercial Inflatables](https://yicinflatables.com/): Manufacturer overview, production capability, buyer use cases, compliance guidance, and quotation options.
- [Product Catalog](https://yicinflatables.com/products/): Commercial inflatable categories and individual product pages.
- [About YIC](https://yicinflatables.com/about/): Factory information, materials, process, customer feedback, exhibitions, and compliance document library.
- [Buyer Resources](https://yicinflatables.com/blog/): Buying guides for sourcing, OEM/ODM, materials, compliance, rental operations, and international shipping.
- [Buyer FAQ](https://yicinflatables.com/faq/): Product, customization, quality, documentation, quotation, shipping, and ordering questions.
- [Request a Quote](https://yicinflatables.com/contact/): Send product, quantity, dimensions, destination market, branding, and delivery requirements.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yicinflatables.com/privacy/): How website and quotation information is handled.
- [Website Terms](https://yicinflatables.com/terms/): Catalog, quotation, compliance, and operating information.
- [Shipping and Support](https://yicinflatables.com/shipping/): Packing, warranty, accessories, and after-sales planning.

## Accuracy Notes

- Product specifications, materials, included accessories, lead time, MOQ, freight, and compliance documents must be confirmed for the requested model and destination market.
- Certificates and test reports are product-, component-, and market-specific. They should not be treated as universal approval for every product.
- For custom projects, buyers should provide a reference image, artwork or logo, dimensions, quantity, intended use, and destination market.
